script.title: Real bank (false alarm)
script.summary: A real bank warns Margaret about an odd charge and says it will never ask for a PIN or code. Decider reads the words PIN and password as an ask, so the gate freezes the payment. The family calls, sees it is real, and releases it.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is Margaret's bank calling about a small charge that looked unusual.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: It was a twelve dollar purchase at a hardware store in another city. Nothing has been blocked.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Then please call the number on the back of your card and we will cancel it for you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We will never ask for your PIN, your password or any codes on the phone, so please don't share them with anyone.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Alright, I'll call the number on my card. Thank you.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: You're welcome. Have a good day.

payment_attempt.request: Pay my usual phone bill of $45 to Northline Mobile.

events.text:
Your parent’s payment to Northline Mobile ($45) was paused—this call looked like a scam.  
“We will never ask for your PIN, your password or any codes on the phone, so please don't share them with anyone.”  
“Hello, this is Margaret's bank calling about a small charge that looked unusual.”  
Please call them soon. Reply KEEP if it’s safe, or RELEASE if you want the payment to go through. We’re here to help.
events.sent:
Held action: pay_bill {'payee': 'Northline Mobile', 'amount': 45}
The call has two worrying moments, shown as {Q1} and {Q2}.

events.text:
A caller claimed to be from [PARENT]’s bank about an unusual $12 charge, triggering an amber gate.  
The caller then asked the family to call the number on the back of the card to cancel it, another amber signal.  
When the caller stated they would never ask for PINs, passwords, or codes, the system triggered a red gate.  
The family paused the pending $45 bill payment to Northline Mobile.  
After contacting [PARENT] directly, the family replied RELEASE and confirmed no fraud occurred.
events.sent:

- Step 1: caller said “Hello, this is [PARENT]'s bank calling about a small charge that looked unusual.” (gate amber)
- Step 2: caller said “It was a twelve dollar purchase at a hardware store in another city. Nothing has been blocked.” (gate amber)
- Step 3: caller said “Then please call the number on the back of your card and we will cancel it for you.” (gate amber)
- Step 4: caller said “We will never ask for your PIN, your password or any codes on the phone, so please don't share them with anyone.” (gate red)
- Held: pay_bill {'payee': 'Northline Mobile', 'amount': 45}. Balance unchanged at $12,450.00.
- The family replied RELEASE after calling their parent.
